title: Operations Leader
description:
Want to help pets live their best lives?


We’re proud to be where the pets go and where the pet people go. If you want to make a real difference, create an exciting career path, feel welcome to be your whole self and nurture your wellbeing, Petco is the place for you.


Our core values capture that spirit as we work to improve lives by doing what’s right for pets and people.


  • Pet First – Protect & Empower. All pets should Live their Best Life. We put the needs of pets and pet parents at the center of everything we do.

  • Foster the Fun – Connect & Bond. Our Passion for pets brings us together! We celebrate the journey of pet parenthood through distinct experiences, products, and services.

  • Let’s Go! Own & Commit. We are stronger as One Petco team. We bring our unique superpowers and champion authenticity in everyone to drive success.

About Petco:


We’re proud to be "where the pets go" to find everything they need to live their best lives for more than 60 years — from their favorite meals and toys, to trusted supplies and expert support from people who get it, because we live it. We believe in the universal truths of pet parenthood — the boundless boops, missing slippers, late night zoomies and everything in between. And we’re here for it. Every tail wag, every vet visit, every step of the way. We are 29,000+ strong and together we nurture the pet-human bond in more than 1,500 Petco stores across the U.S., Mexico and Puerto Rico, 250+ Vetco Total Care hospitals, hundreds of preventive care clinics and eight distribution centers. In 1999, we founded Petco Love. Together, we support thousands of local animal welfare groups nationwide and have helped find homes for approximately 7 million animals through in-store adoption events.



As a Key Holder, you are a trusted member of the leadership team who helps ensure smooth daily operations, exceptional customer service, and a safe, secure environment for pets, partners, and customers.

You support store leadership by supervising partners, opening and closing the store, and serving as a point of contact when management is not present. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys leading on the floor, solving problems in the moment, and delivering a great experience every day.

What You’ll Do

Pet First

  • Uphold Petco’s animal care standards, ensuring the health, safety, and proper handling of all animals.
  • Promote a safe, welcoming environment for pets, pet parents, and partners.
  • Follow all policies and procedures related to animal welfare, safety, and store operations.

Foster the Fun

  • Deliver friendly, knowledgeable, and solution-oriented service to every customer.
  • Support and supervise store partners, helping maintain productivity and positive morale.
  • Assist with training new partners and reinforcing best practices on the sales floor.
  • Help maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store environment.

Let’s Go!

  • Open and close the store while following all cash handling, safety, and security protocols.
  • Support daily store operations including sales, task execution, and recovery.
  • Execute merchandising standards, including planograms, pricing accuracy, signage, and promotional set-ups.
  • Assist with inventory activities such as restocking, cycle counts, inventory integrity, and required inventory paperwork.
  • Identify out-of-stocks, low inventory, or merchandising issues and communicate them to store leadership.
  • Process transactions, refunds, and exchanges accurately and efficiently.
  • Act as the primary point of contact in the absence of store management.
  • Support sales initiatives and promotions to help achieve store goals.

Key Responsibilities

Store Operations, Merchandising & Inventory

  • Maintain merchandise presentation and in-stock conditions to Petco standards.
  • Ensure accurate pricing and signage throughout the store.
  • Assist with inventory counts, product replenishment, and shrink awareness.
  • Monitor merchandising and inventory conditions during shifts and escalate issues as needed.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and safety standards.

Customer Experience & Leadership

  • Address customer questions and resolve concerns promptly and professionally.
  • Model Petco’s selling behaviors and service expectations.
  • Provide guidance and direction to partners during assigned shifts.
  • Escalate concerns appropriately to store leadership.

What Success Looks Like

  • The store opens and closes safely and smoothly.
  • Merchandise is well-stocked, accurately priced, and visually appealing.
  • Inventory is handled accurately and with care.
  • Customers receive prompt, friendly, and knowledgeable service.
  • Partners feel supported and clear on expectations during each shift.

What You Bring

Experience & Skills

  • Previous retail experience required; key holder or supervisory experience preferred.
  • Strong leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Ability to multitask and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Basic math skills and experience handling cash and transactions.
  • Reliable, responsible, and detail oriented.

Essential Functions & Work Environment

This role is primarily performed in a Pet Care Center retail environment. The Key Holder is expected to be regularly present on the sales floor, leading by example and engaging with partners, customers, and pets.

  • Majority of work is conducted indoors; however, occasional duties may require leaving the Pet Care Center for tasks such as bank deposits, merchandise transport, or community events.
  • The role requires frequent standing and walking, as well as bending, kneeling, reaching, and lifting.
  • Ability to safely lift and move merchandise, supplies, or animals weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Regular engagement with customers on the sales floor, including providing customer assistance and performing cashiering and point-of-sale transactions.
  • Must be able to work in proximity to animals, including exposure to animal dander, odors, noises, and cleaning chemicals.
  • Flexible availability to support Pet Care Center operating hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • A limited amount of travel may be required for training, meetings, or community engagement.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Purpose-driven work that makes a difference for pets and people.
  • Opportunities to build leadership skills and grow your career.
  • A collaborative, inclusive team culture.
  • A strong stepping stone for future leadership opportunities.

Petco Animal Supplies, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Position Title:

OSH Director of Site Operations 12 Month Job Rotation

Job Description:

Deputy of Site Operations (Job Rotation)-Oregon State Hospital

We have an exciting Administrator level 12-month job rotation opportunity for current State of Oregon employees only. At the Oregon State Hospital, you will join our leadership team temporarily to focus on specific operational deliverables, as outlined below and included in the attached position description. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone experienced in complex facility management in an institutional or locked facility setting. The Deputy of Site Operations will be responsible for developing structured operational programs that support safety, security and continuity of site services across the hospital, 24/7/365.

Oregon State Hospital, a Joint Commission and CMS certified public psychiatric hospital, provides psychiatric evaluation, diagnosis and treatment for mentally and emotionally ill adult and geriatric populations committed by the Oregon courts as part of the state mental health system. The Oregon State Hospital is the largest division of Oregon Health Authority with approximately 3,000 positions across the hospital, approximately 700 patients across two campuses, one in Salem and the other in Junction City.

OSH Vision: We are a psychiatric hospital that inspires hope, promotes safety, and supports recovery for all.

OSH Mission: to provide therapeutic, evidence-based, patient-centered treatment focusing on recovery and community reintegration, all in a safe environment.

OSH Values

  • Humanity
  • Equity
  • Wellness
  • Partnership
  • Transparency
  • Performance Excellence

Position Overview

This position is a key part of Oregon State Hospital's administrative operations, reporting directly to the CFO/COO, under Business and Site Operations. The Business and Site Operations section guides and oversees administrative, finance and site operations across the hospital system. The departments of this section provide structure and support to direct care operations in the areas of: safety, security, training and education, technology services, facilities management, general operations, patient financial services, fiscal, budget, data and analysis, and utilization management.

Operations Management Duties

  • Direct and oversee the development of a full-scale Emergency Management Plan that ensures patient care and safety in the event of a significant emergency. This plan will include a Continuity of Operations Plan (COOP) consistent with Oregon Health Authority and the Governor’s priorities.
  • Oversee the development of reports and management studies related to OSH site operations, resource development and cost recovery to evaluate program activities. Report findings and recommended changes to CFO/COO and Senior Leadership.
  • Oversee departments that comprise Site Operations – Safety, Security, and Facilities and Support Operations for OSH. Provides guidance to department directors on design, implementation, and evaluation of business systems, practices and administrative processes.
  • Ensure coordination across all assigned units to work in collaboration with other departments across OSH. Identifies opportunities to reduce barriers, identify and mitigate risks, improve efficiency and ensure effectiveness of business processes.
  • Provide management direction on hospital-wide, non-clinical operational issues that lie outside of other OSH functional areas.
  • Provide oversight of statements of work and business components of contracts and agreements. Serve as contract administrator for cross-section contracts, monitoring and evaluating contractor performance.

Leadership Responsibilities

  • Act on behalf of the CFO/COO to drive OSH priority initiatives that cross over multiple departments and functional areas. Convene and lead workgroups.
  • Ensure administrative and operational alignment across campuses in support of patient centered services.
  • Serve as a key advisor to the CFO/COO and OSH Sr Leadership Team on hospital-wide site operational matters.
  • Advise and assist OSH with division, and section goal setting, policy making, and strategic planning.
  • Lead programs in a manner encompassing the overall hospital strategic direction and identified priorities.
  • Participate in OSH-wide and agency-wide workgroups to establish policies and protocols. Represent OSH as delegate for CFO/COO on Agency workgroups and committees.
  • Assist in coordinating activities with other agencies in areas of mutual concern to ensure compliance with established policies, objectives, program priorities and applicable laws, rules and regulations.

Work Environment

This position’s daily work is performed within a psychiatric hospital environment in the presence of people experiencing or living with mental illness whose behavior may be unpredictable and may act out verbally or physically. The nature of this work will require that you be able to flex hours when necessary to complete time sensitive projects or ensure the safe and efficient operation of our 24/7/365 operation, traveling from Salem to Junction City on a weekly or bi-weekly basis.

Oregon State Hospital-Who We Are

For a full review of the position description, click here.

If this opportunity aligns with your strengths, background, and commitment to fostering inclusivity, we encourage you to apply! At the Oregon Health Authority (OHA), we value diversity and encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to help us build a stronger, more equitable future for all.

Minimum Qualifications

Five years of management experience; OR two years of management experience and a bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Desired Attributes

  • Demonstrated experience in developing and actively maintaining an emergency preparedness program, preferably for a hospital or institution.
  • Proven ability to design and oversee emergency response protocols, including live events, drills and table-top exercises. Must have demonstrated experience and competency in developing Continuity of Operations Plans (COOP).
  • Thorough knowledge of security operations in a locked facility/institution that allows incumbent to oversee strategy and development of security strategies. Experience leading operations is preferred.
  • Experience with the Project Management Body of Knowledge (PMBOK), LEAN principles strongly desired.
  • Demonstrated experience in negotiation of contracts and agreements.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and facilitating large committees containing members with diverse perspectives.
  • Experience establishing vision, strategy, setting long-range administrative direction, and establishing cross agency policies, goals and functional requirements.
  • Experience in and understanding of state, local and federal government systems and operations.

How to Apply:

At the time of application, ensure the work history in your applicant profile is up to date, and attach a current copy of your resume and cover letter. Please include in your application (1) a cover letter (2 pages maximum) addressing how you meet the minimum qualifications and desired attributes and preferences as appropriate and (2) a resume detailing your lived, learned and professional experience.

*Failure to provide a resume or cover letter will disqualify you from consideration.

  • Internal Candidates: Current State of Oregon employees must apply through the employee Workday login. Be sure to follow all application submission requirements.
  • If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact: Melissa M. Perez at (503) 949-3078 or melissa.m.perez@oha.oregon.gov

After You Apply:

  • Before the job announcement closes, log in to your Workday account to check for pending tasks under “My Applications” and complete them.
  • Remember to check your email (including your junk folder) and Workday inbox for updates on your application.
  • We value our veterans! To ensure the security of your information, kindly follow the instructions for how to submit your Veteran documents for preference found here. Please do not attach your Veterans’ preference documentation in the Resume/CV field of your application.

Reminders:

  • Your candidate profile and application materials are great opportunities to showcase your interest in the position and highlight your skills and experience. Submissions will be screened for consistency and communication skills, including attention to detail, spelling, and grammar. For more tips and guidance, check out What you need to know to get the job!
  • This announcement is for one, 12 month Job Rotation, Deputy of Sight Operations Business Operations Administrator 1 classification SR38 based in Salem, Oregon.
  • This is an on-site position. Please check SECTION 4. WORKING CONDITIONS, of the position description linked above to review more details regarding the details surrounding the working conditions.
  • Please download and save a copy of this job announcement and linked position description, as it is not available after the application deadline.
  • This is an open opportunity for current State of Oregon employees to apply. We encourage you to review and follow the instructions for applying carefully.

Additional Details

  • Employment at Oregon State Hospital is contingent upon passing a background check including a criminal records check, drug screen, and a driving records check that meets OHA criteria at the time of hire and throughout employment.

title: Beauty Therapist
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Beauty Therapist is responsible for delivering high‑quality waxing, skincare, and spa treatments while ensuring exceptional guest care and safety. This role includes assessing guest needs, identifying contraindications, recommending appropriate treatments, and promoting home‑care products. The Beauty Therapist maintains treatment rooms, adheres to hygiene and safety protocols, and supports overall spa operations by maintaining professionalism and service excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide professional beauty and spa treatments, including waxing and skincare services, in accordance with brand standards and guest needs.
  • Conduct thorough consultations by assessing skin condition, identifying contraindications, and determining the most suitable treatment options.
  • Educate guests on proper skincare routines and recommend appropriate retail products and home‑care regimens.
  • Promote and sell spa services and retail offerings to enhance guest wellbeing and drive revenue.
  • Escort guests to and from treatment rooms, ensuring comfort, privacy, and a seamless spa experience.
  • Prepare and maintain clean, well‑organized treatment rooms by setting up equipment, products, and supplies before each service.
  • Clean, sanitize, and properly store all tools and equipment to meet health and safety standards.
  • Adhere to scheduled treatment times, manage appointments efficiently, and maintain accurate service records.
  • Professionally manage inappropriate guest behavior by ceasing the service and informing the supervisor/manager immediately.
  • Follow all company policies, safety procedures, and confidentiality guidelines, and complete required training and certifications.
  • Maintain professional grooming, communication, and conduct; support teamwork and uphold quality standards.
  • Perform other reasonable duties as assigned by Supervisors.

Qualifications & Experience

Required:

  • Diploma in Beauty & Spa Therapy or equivalent formal training.

Preferred:

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in a spa, salon, or beauty therapy environment.
  • Strong knowledge of skincare, waxing techniques, and professional beauty products.
  • Excellent consultation and communication skills with the ability to build guest trust.
  • Ability to maintain high hygiene standards and follow safety protocols.
  • Strong customer‑service mindset, sales ability, and a warm, professional personality.
  • Must have legal working rights in Fiji.

This role is island‑based and requires working on a rostered stay‑on‑island schedule.

title: Freelance Researcher- Premier League
description:
NBC Sports is looking for a researcher with a focus on supporting our coverage of the Premier League. The position will require sound editorial judgment, quick decision making, and the ability to interact with on-air talent and production staff in the lead-up to and during live studio and match coverage. This role is for passionate Premier League soccer fans with exceptional writing skills and attention to detail who want to play a key role in our storytelling. Candidates should also be flexible and prepared to support and contribute to research projects across NBC Sports properties, as assigned.

Responsibilities include:

· Develop, compile and circulate information – such as press clippings, player bios and match previews – on all matters related to the Premier League, including the clubs, players, managers, rules and league-wide storylines

· Maintain the accuracy and integrity of on-air content

· Be a constructive teammate by working closely with other members of the production and research teams to develop storylines, pitch ideas, write scripts, and QC graphics and other content

· Prepare on-air talent prior to shows, and provide accurate, on-the-spot information during broadcasts in various capacities, including in studios, control rooms and on remote assignments

· Contribute to production and editorial meetings, and respond to specific research requests from departments across NBC Sports

· Become an expert on the stories, athletes, rules, results and histories of the Premier League and its clubs

· Minimum one (1) year of experience in sports journalism or related field or equivalent work experience

· Knowledge of and passion for Premier League soccer

· Excellent writing skills with proven journalistic writing ability (submission of writing samples required)

· Demonstrated editorial judgment and commitment to accuracy

· Ability to work efficiently and effectively under pressure and meet deadlines

· Strong interpersonal and communication skills

Desired Characteristics:

· Previous demonstrated excellence working on a national or regional sports television production or equivalent experience is strongly preferred

· Candidates should be versatile, self-motivated, energetic and able to work well both independently and as part of a group

· Sound editorial judgment and clear, efficient writing ability

· Strong background in journalism – specifically, experience as a senior writer or editor at a college or professional daily newspaper or top line magazine

· Experience with providing sports information for on-air broadcasters

· Ability to work efficiently and accurately under pressure, meet deadlines, sustain focus on assigned duties and multitask

· Experience in news gathering and/or working in studio production

· Strong working knowledge of various research sources and methods

title: Recreation Facility Supervisor (Night Shift)
description:
Position Title:

Recreation Facility Supervisor (Night Shift)

Job Posting Closing Date:

***OPEN UNTIL FILLED***
[Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.]

Provo City is seeking a dependable, responsible, and people-oriented individual for a part-time Recreation Facility Supervisor position at Peaks Ice Arena. This role serves as the night supervisor, overseeing operations and facility management during recreational hours.

Job Details

What is the compensation?

Pay Rate: $13.00 - $18.00 per hour (depending on experience)

Part-time Provo City employees are eligible to contribute to individual retirement savings plans through the City (401k, 457, Roth IRA, and/or Traditional IRA) and receive the following great benefits: a) free admission to the Provo Recreation Center, Peaks Ice Arena Public Skating, and Provo Shooting Sports Park; b) a free Provo City Library Card; c) a 25% discount on Provo Recreation Center memberships (direct family only); and d) discounts from various local and national vendors.

What will I do?

  • Oversee operations and staff for the ice arena.

  • Ensure the facility and its programs are maintained throughout a scheduled shift including, admissions, rentals, concessions, and general facility maintenance and upkeep.

  • Manage patron concerns, safety incidents, and crowd flow.

  • Assist full-time personnel and other employees as required.

What requirements do I need to apply?

  • Must be 18 years of age.

  • Sufficient experience and/or training which would demonstrate an ability to successfully perform the duties of the job.

  • Ability to learn quickly.

  • Customer service experience required.

  • Supervisory experience preferred.

What are the hours?

This position oversees the Ice Arena Monday-Friday during the nighttime shift from approximately 5:00 p.m. to 2:00 a.m. Employees will generally work either a Monday/Wednesday/Friday schedule or a Tuesday/Thursday/Saturday schedule. Typical workload is 15-25 hours per week.

What are the physical and environmental factors?

This position requires interaction with the public in busy and often stressful circumstances. This position is indoors with specialty conditions that are associated with operating an ice rink including cool temperatures and bright lights.

What is the selection process?

This position is open until filled and will be closed when sufficient, qualified applications to proceed with a competitive selection process have been received (at least seven days). Applications will be reviewed in the order they are submitted. Applicants must meet the minimum qualifications listed above to be eligible for consideration.

If selected for hire, candidate will be required to successfully pass a drug screen and criminal background check. Non-disclosure may result in dismissal. Applicants with unsatisfactory drug screen results will be ineligible for appointment or application to any Provo City position for a minimum period of six (6) months.

Why Provo City?

Provo is consistently recognized nationally for its outstanding quality of life, well-being, and as a beautiful place to live. Visit provo.gov to learn more!

Provo City is an equal employment opportunity employer.

title: Senior Field Service Technician  - Flexibles
description:
TOPPAN Packaging Americas specializes in designing and manufacturing sustainable, high-performance flexible and thermoformed packaging solutions for the food, beverage, medical and consumer goods industries. We offer products like transparent high barrier films, pouches, clamshells and trays, utilizing advanced technology to enhance product safety, visibility and environmental sustainability.

TOPPAN Packaging Americas operates as part of the global TOPPAN group, with 22 manufacturing facilities across North America, Latin America and Europe.

Want to learn more? Visit us at packaging.toppan.com

Summary Description

The Field Technical Engineer for the Flexibles Division is one of the main technical contacts between the customers’ production teams and TOPPAN. This position is responsible for qualification and technical service activity at assigned accounts. This position works closely with the Account Development team, who are constantly iterating, solving problems, and working together to develop packaging solutions that are cost-effective, product-safety complaint, more sustainable, and satisfy customers’ needs.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Work closely with the Commercial Team and Account Development Team to identify and successfully commercialize flexible packaging opportunities at targeted accounts.
  • Support customer trials as needed to qualify new flexible packaging structures, drive cost savings, and improve product performance.
  • Help to translate customer requirements to TOPPAN Technical personnel to build specifications and develop manufacturing instructions for our materials.
  • Define project success criteria, draw conclusions based on data and experience, make technical recommendations, and manage projects. Projects are often fast-paced and have high visibility.
  • Provide routine technical service activity by visiting key accounts and spending time on their production floors to build relationships and optimize their processes related to our film use.
  • Building and maintaining strong operational and maintenance department customer relations, as well as building relationships at all levels of the customer organization.
  • Respond to customer demands with verbal, written and in-person support when challenges arise for the customer, particularly involving material that has been placed into quarantine by the customer. Work directly with the customer as needed to determine if acceptable operating conditions can be identified to allow the customer to consume the quarantined material while maintaining standard quality levels for their customers.
  • Preparing written call reports for all customer visits that are accurate, professional, and informative, and that distinguish between internal confidential information for internal circulation only, and sanitized information that can be shared with the customer as necessary.
  • Learn all aspects of packaging equipment used by our customers via training by OEM suppliers and industry experts, and by attending trade shows and building relationships with equipment vendors to allow proper support for our customers. Become the “TOPPAN Expert” for operation and optimization of this packaging equipment.
  • Travel domestically and internationally to manufacturing plants, suppliers, customers, conferences, and other innovation partners.
  • Maintain complete and accurate work records and call reports.

This is a progression position and level will be based on candidate experience and business needs.

description:

If you’d like the chance to make your mark with the world’s largest equipment rental provider, come build your future with United Rentals!

The Driver CDL A - Mobile Storage is responsible for safely delivering, setting, and picking up storage containers, ground-level office units and office trailers using company-provided roll-off or tilt-bed trucks. This position plays a key role in representing the company at customer job sites by ensuring professional interaction, documenting deliveries accurately, and following all safety and DOT requirements. Drivers also support yard operations as needed, including cleaning, basic repairs, and organizing equipment.   • Collaborate with branch operations and dispatch teams to coordinate delivery and pickup schedules, and report any delays, site issues, equipment issues, or safety concerns.

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

  • Ability to perform physical work, including climbing, lifting, and use of tools for set-up and leveling.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team.
  • Clear DOT drug test history.
  • Knowledge of GVW’s, state regulations regarding height and weight maximums.

title: Senior Security Engineer, Proactive Security
description:
The Senior Security Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for independently driving security initiatives across multiple services and teams. This role requires deep technical expertise in application security, threat modeling, and secure system design, combined with the ability to influence engineering teams and deliver high-impact security outcomes with minimal guidance.


Key job responsibilities
Security Reviews & Assessments: Lead end-to-end security reviews for complex, high-priority services including design reviews, threat modeling, and penetration testing scoping and readout
Technical Leadership: Serve as a subject matter expert for assigned affinity teams, providing architectural guidance and security consultation to service teams throughout the development lifecycle
Threat Modeling: Independently perform and guide threat modeling exercises for complex distributed systems, identifying risks and recommending mitigations
Manual Code Review: Conduct targeted manual code reviews of security-critical components, identifying vulnerabilities and insecure patterns that automated tools miss
Penetration Testing: Scope, coordinate, and oversee penetration testing engagements; analyze results and drive remediation with service teams
Findings Management: Identify, document, and track security findings to resolution; escalate critical issues to leadership when appropriate
Mentorship & Influence: Mentor junior engineers, contribute to team processes and tooling improvements, and raise the security bar across the organization
Design & Build Security Tooling: Design and build security automation, tooling, and processes that improve operational efficiency and scale the team's impact
AI-Powered Security Automation: Leverage generative AI and machine learning to build intelligent security automations that streamline review workflows, enhance vulnerability detection, and reduce manual toil
Builder Engagement: Partner with service teams to improve security posture proactively, including developing self-service guidance, documentation, and readiness frameworks
Metrics & Reporting: Define and track security metrics that measure risk reduction, operational efficiency, and builder experience improvements


About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Personal Lines Casualty Team!

Applicants residing in Washington state, California, or the District of Columbia are not eligible at this time.

title: SDE-III SP Agentic Interfaces, Spectrum — Selling Partner Developer Experience
description:
The Spectrum organization owns critical platform infrastructure that hundreds of thousands of third-party Solution Providers depend on to build applications powering millions of Amazon sellers. Our services process billions of API calls, manage complex permission and authorization models across global marketplaces, and serve as the front door for every Solution Provider building on Amazon's commerce platform. We're looking for a senior technical leader to own the architecture and drive delivery of agentic AI systems within our platform. This is a role for someone who sees the full picture — you'll take ambiguous business problems, define the technology strategy, and lead your team through delivery of production AI agent systems that fundamentally reshape how Solution Providers interact with our platform. You'll proactively identify architecture deficiencies, simplify complex systems, and make trade-offs between short-term business needs and long-term technology investments. Your influence will extend beyond your team as you drive alignment with partner teams on coherent architectural strategies.

Key job responsibilities
* Own team-level architecture for agentic AI systems — define how AI agents interact with your team's platform services (authorization, permissions, notifications, identity, and developer workflows). Proactively fix architecture deficiencies and simplify existing systems.
* Lead large, complex AI initiatives end-to-end — decompose ambiguous problem statements into parallel workstreams, assign components to team members, and reassemble into cohesive launches. You know when to build new and when to extend existing solutions.
* Design AI agent frameworks and platform architecture including tool-use orchestration, context retrieval (RAG over developer docs, API specs, and account data), guardrails, memory systems, and evaluation pipelines — making trade-offs between extensibility, performance, and operational complexity.
* Leverage AI-DLC to build world-class experiences for Sellers and Solution Providers to discover and leverage agentic capabilities across their interface of choice.
* Build intelligent automation for high-volume operational workflows: vetting tools with human-in-the-loop, agentic ticket triage and resolution, proactive Solution Provider health monitoring, automated onboarding guidance, and self-service diagnostic tools.
* Define metrics, evaluation frameworks, and guardrails for AI agent quality — accuracy, resolution rate, latency, safety, drift detection — and build the instrumentation to measure and improve them in production. Drive A/B testing of model outputs and establish feedback loops.
* Drive engineering excellence across the team — set standards for code quality, operational excellence, security, and testability. Resolve root causes of endemic problems including areas where your team's systems bottleneck other teams' innovation.
* Operate at Amazon scale — own Tier-1 services across multiple regions. Make principled trade-offs between short-term operational needs and long-term technology investments. Maintain the high availability bar expected of platform infrastructure.
* Influence technical direction beyond your team — lead architecture reviews, drive design alignment with partner teams across the Spectrum organization, and negotiate technical decisions where systems intersect. Build consensus across discordant views.
* Actively mentor and develop team members — coach SDEs on design approaches, lead technical assessments, raise the engineering bar through code reviews, and ensure the team is stronger because of your presence but does not require it to be successful.

A day in the life
The average day is focused on delivering upon our prioritized product features and collaborating with members of the team on planning and designing future features.

We gather on a daily Scrum to support each other in our work and help overcome blockers as a team.

About the team
The team owns the API endpoint that millions of selling partners around the world use to manage their business on Amazon's stores. As part of the team, you have the chance to make a significant impact on our systems, our business, and most importantly, our customers by building highly scalable, reliable, and extensible systems. If you work backward from customer needs are committed to getting things done, then explore joining our team!

Level 2 – Developing (2–5 years)

Level 3 – Advanced (5+ years)

  • Assisting outside sales in supporting contractor bids and project opportunities
  • Perform HVAC take-offs, estimating, and product selection/pricing
  • Prepare quotations, proposals, and submittals
  • Enter and manage customer orders and project documentation

Operational Excellence

Qualifications

  • Experience in construction, HVAC, mechanical contracting, or distribution preferred
  • Familiarity with estimating, take-offs, quoting, or project coordination
  • Strong organizational skills with ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

title: PhD scholarship: Mode of Action Studies of Marine Bacillus Probiotics Using Multi-omics Approaches
description:
We are currently looking for a PhD candidate to undertake research on the mode of action of marine Bacillus probiotics using advanced multi-omics approaches. This project forms part of a larger collaborative research initiative between Griffith University, Bioproton Pty Ltd and the Marine Bioproducts Cooperative Research Centre (MBCRC).

The project provides an opportunity to develop high-level skills in microbiology, probiotic research, metabolomics, microbiome analysis, bioinformatics and systems biology, while working in a collaborative academic–industry environment. The successful candidate will engage with industry partners and MBCRC to gain insight into product development, regulatory requirements and commercial translation, and will be supported to disseminate research outcomes through publications, presentations and collaborative activities relevant to Australia’s growing marine bioproducts sector.

This position is primarily based at Griffith University Brisbane South (Nathan). As Griffith is a multi-campus University you may be required to work across other campus locations. Griffith University’s sites are located on the lands of the Yugarabul, Yuggera, Jagera, Turrbal, Yugambeh and Kombumerri peoples.

The successful applicant should have a strong academic background in microbiology, biotechnology, biochemistry, molecular biology, bioinformatics, or a related discipline. You will have evidence of curiosity, initiative and a strong interest in applying advanced research methods to understand host–microbe interactions and the mechanisms underpinning probiotic efficacy. The successful applicant will be expected to work both independently and as part of a collaborative research team, communicate effectively with academic and industry partners, and contribute to publications, presentations and project reporting.

  • Expressions of interest are welcome from domestic and onshore international applicants and international applicants. If you are an international applicant who is currently offshore please consider the viability of travelling costs before submitting an expression of interest. Please see the FAQs web page for requirements for offshore international applicants.
  • Applicants must have completed, or expect to complete, a bachelors degree with First Class Honours (H1) or equivalent, or a master's degree (AQF Level 9) with a substantial research component demonstrating academic excellence. Honours Class 2A or equivalent are encouraged to apply. Masters degree incorporating a significant research component of a standard comparable to a bachelor honours degree or be regarded by Griffith University as having an equivalent level of attainment in accordance with the Equivalent qualifications for HDR program admission. For further information on the eligibility requirements for the program refer here.

Applicants are advised that the following skills are highly desirable:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving, with the ability to design and conduct independent research.
  • Experience with microbiome analysis, next-generation sequencing, bioinformatics, molecular microbiology, cell culture, immunological assays, metabolomics or systems biology approaches.
  • Experience working in industry, clinical, translational or collaborative research environments.
  • Evidence of competitive scholarships, academic awards or research excellence prizes.
  • Programming and data analysis skills

About the scholarship
This scholarship is a MBCRC PhD scholarship providing a stipend of AUD $60,000 per annum for a period of up to 3.5 years, subject to satisfactory progress and continued enrolment in the doctoral program. The scholarship is intended to support a full-time PhD candidate undertaking this industry-linked research project.

The scholarship will be awarded in accordance with Griffith University’s higher degree research scholarship conditions and any applicable project funding requirements.

What Griffith offers
As a scholarship holder, you will study with Griffith University that ranks among the top 2% worldwide and spans across campuses in South East Queensland. At Griffith University, we’ve worked hard to create a culture that will challenge you to be curious, creative and courageous. We also support the professional and personal development of all our HDR candidates and invest in the skills of our people. Griffith University values diversity, inclusion and flexibility and we encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. Griffith's strategic goals are to also increase the proportion of women in senior academic and administrative roles and in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics and Medicine (STEMM).

At the Institute for Biomedicine and Glycomics, you will join a collaborative and multidisciplinary research environment with access to experienced supervisors, advanced laboratory facilities and expertise across microbiology, natural product chemistry, bioanalysis, glycomics, metabolomics and translational biomedical research. The Institute provides a supportive setting for HDR candidates to develop as independent researchers while engaging with interdisciplinary teams and external partners.

Through this project, you will be supported to build technical and analytical capability in multi-omics approaches, microbiome and metabolomic data interpretation, probiotic mechanism-of-action studies and industry-relevant research translation. The project will also provide opportunities to interact with Bioproton Pty Ltd and MBCRC, enabling you to gain practical insight into industry-led research priorities, product development pathways, regulatory considerations and commercial translation. You will also have opportunities to contribute to publications, present findings to academic and industry audiences, and gain experience working within a research program connected to Australia’s emerging marine bioproducts sector.

EOI Process

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
Parallel Systems is pioneering autonomous battery-electric rail vehicles designed to transform freight transportation by shifting portions of the $900 billion U.S. trucking industry onto rail. Our innovative technology offers cleaner, safer, and more efficient logistics solutions. Join our dynamic team and help shape a smarter, greener future for global freight.

Technical Program Manager

Parallel Systems is looking for a Technical Program Manager to lead execution across our vehicle hardware, autonomy systems, and enterprise software. This is the first TPM hire at the company - a critical role responsible for keeping engineering efforts aligned as we develop and scale the next generation of autonomous rail vehicles.

You’ll work cross-functionally with mechanical, electrical, firmware, and software teams to track progress, manage timelines, surface risks, and ensure seamless integration across all parts of the system. From tracking hardware builds and test cycles to coordinating software and firmware dependencies, you’ll drive programs that sit at the heart of our product roadmap.

This role demands strong communication, technical depth, organizational rigor, attention to detail, and a bias for action. You should thrive in fast-paced environments, be comfortable in the details of physical systems, and bring structure to complex, multi-disciplinary development efforts.

Responsibilities

  • Work with leadership to own and manage the integrated master schedule (IMS) that owns the hardware, software, and product deliveries
  • Coordinate timelines, priorities, and deliverables across hardware, firmware, and software teams for both current and next generation platforms
  • Track milestones, manage risks, and drive resolution on blockers
  • Ensure alignment on requirements between engineering, product, and customer teams
  • Facilitate regular syncs, status reporting, and planning sessions
  • Create and maintain documentation to support clear visibility and execution at all levels
  • Support development and integration of new vehicle generations, enterprise software upgrades, and firmware iterations

What Success Looks Like

  • After 30 Days: You’ve ramped up on our development processes, tools, and teams, and established a clear understanding of the current vehicle and software stack. You own and maintain the cross-functional integrated master schedule (IMS). You’ve begun managing active programs and created an execution dashboard with forward-looking key timelines.
  • After 60 Days: You’re driving weekly program updates across hardware, software, and firmware teams, surfacing cross-functional risks and pushing clarity on critical path items. You’ve led coordination on at least one major cross-functional release, with a clear post-mortem process in place. You’ve introduced process improvements that enhance visibility and delivery speed.
  • After 90 Days: You’re seen as a go-to partner for program planning and execution across the company. You’ve identified and mitigated future risks for the company across critical path items.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in technical program management or engineering program roles
  • Strong technical background with experience working closely with hardware and software teams
  • Proven track record of delivering complex, cross-functional programs on time and budget
  • Exceptional organizational and communication skills
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, and program tracking tools
  • Ability to manage ambiguity and drive clarity in a high-growth startup environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in transportation, robotics, or hardware/software integrated systems
  • Familiarity with product development lifecycles or NPI processes
  • Experience working with enterprise software platforms or freight industry tools

title: M04 - Senior UX Designer
description:
We are looking for a Senior UX Designer / UX Lead who combines a deep understanding of human behaviour, cognitive psychology, and design thinking to craft exceptional user experiences. You will play a pivotal role in planning, designing, and executing UX strategies that transform complex challenges into intuitive and engaging digital solutions.

Key Responsibilities﻿

  • Plan and conduct user research including interviews, surveys, workshops, usability testing, and A/B testing.
  • Analyse research findings to translate user insights and behavioural data into actionable design opportunities.
  • Apply knowledge of cognitive biases, decision-making processes, and human psychology to inform design strategies.
  • Create wireframes, user flows, and prototypes (low- to high-fidelity) using tools such as Figma.
  • Test and iterate design concepts with users to refine experiences and ensure alignment with user mental models.
  • Deliver design solutions that are elegant, intuitive, and aligned with both user needs and business goals.
  • Drive iterative design improvements based on user feedback, stakeholder input, and performance metrics.
  • Champion human-centred design principles and behavioural insights to optimise user journeys and interfaces.
  • Partner closely with product managers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure designs are feasible, effective, and aligned with business strategy.
  • Advocate for the user at every stage of the product lifecycle through evidence-based recommendations.
  • Recommend and implement UX tools and methodologies that enhance design quality, collaboration, and efficiency.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of design processes and systems within the organisation.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Minimum 7 years of professional UX design experience.
  • Demonstrated expertise in user behaviour, cognitive principles, and interaction design.
  • Proven ability to apply behavioural insights to create digital experiences that drive user engagement and business results.
  • Strong proficiency with UX tools including Figma, Adobe XD, Miro, UserTesting, Hotjar, or similar.
  • Hands-on experience in research, prototyping, usability testing, A/B testing, design thinking, service design, and accessibility standards.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

title: Data Operations Lead
description:
About the role

You will own the programs that turn research priorities into usable robotics datasets, working with ML researchers, robotics engineers, data engineers, and operations teams to determine what data we need, translate those requirements into collection and annotation programs, and ensure the resulting datasets are delivered with the required quality, coverage, and timing. This is a technically demanding program role. You will not directly build every tool or run every collection shift, but you will understand the complete data lifecycle and drive coordinated execution across the teams responsible for it.

What you’ll do

  • Operationalize the execution of the collection, annotation, validation, and management of our data
  • Translate model-training and evaluation priorities into concrete data requirements, task definitions, collection plans, and acceptance criteria.
  • Own the roadmap and delivery plan for major robotics data programs.
  • Continually improve our process around collecting data and running evals
  • Build internal tools and software to streamline and make our process more efficient

Who You Are

  • You have significant experience in technical program management, ML operations, robotics, autonomy, data platforms, or a related technical field.
  • You have managed complex programs spanning research, software, hardware, and operations.
  • You understand the fundamentals of ML training data, evaluation, dataset quality, and experimentation.
  • You communicate clearly in technical specifications, program reviews, and executive updates.
  • You thrive in an environment where requirements and priorities change quickly.
  • You are comfortable getting your hands dirty, whether that means writing some scrappy code or hopping on a flight to get things done

Bonus Points

  • Experience with robotics, autonomous vehicles, embodied AI, or multimodal ML.
  • Experience with video, sensor, trajectory, or teleoperation datasets.
  • Familiarity with SQL, Python, or direct dataset analysis.
  • Experience designing annotation ontologies or evaluation datasets.
  • Experience coordinating external data vendors or collection partners.

title: Senior Technical Designer in Animation
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Senior Technical Designer in Animation (TDiA) to join our team working across various animation systems. As a TDiA, you will use your animation sense and technical understanding of character animation to design and create gameplay animation systems that facilitate appealing, high-quality character motion. You will be the primary point of contact for animation implementation issues and any animation-related technical challenges, and you will work closely with Animation, Design, and Engineering colleagues to ensure the animation pipeline operates smoothly and efficiently. You will also help identify potential issues and deploy correct solutions, using your technical knowledge to help bridge and facilitate communication between the animation team and other departments.

In this role, you will

  • Create animation behavior tools/techniques/philosophies that allow the building of complex movement systems
  • Design and implement animation state machines/behaviors and runtime solutions
  • Work closely with the Animation, Design, and Engineering departments to analyze, troubleshoot, and solve in-game animation implementation issues and animation-related technical challenges
  • Closely collaborate with the animation leadership to maintain the style and quality bar for animations in the game
  • Look for opportunities to improve the animation pipeline/workflow and help provide solutions for technical animation problems, including performing training and creating documentation for the animation team

What we're looking for

  • A strong animation sense with a clear understanding of realistic and stylized character motion and how to achieve them with modern animation methods
  • Expertise with animation pipelines, including source content creation tools such as Maya, MotionBuilder, and the Unreal Engine, using our Control Rig toolset
  • Exceptional problem-solving ability with strong written communication and teamwork skills
  • Familiarity with gameplay animation tools and concepts, such as blend trees and state machines; experience with Unreal Engine Animation Blueprints is a plus
  • Experience with AAA game development, preferably on a large team using an established game engine (internal or commercial); experience with Unreal Engine is a plus
  • Self-motivation, a strong work ethic, and the ability to work independently
  • Coding knowledge or experience with C++ is not required

This role is open to multiple locations across the US (including CA, NYC, & WA).

Pay Transparency Information

The expected annual base pay range(s) for this position are detailed below. Each base pay range is relevant only for individuals who are residents of or will be expected to work within the specified locale. Compensation varies based on a variety of factors, which include (but aren’t limited to) things such as skills and competencies, qualifications, knowledge, and experience. In addition to base pay, most employees are eligible to participate in Epic’s generous benefit plans and discretionary incentive programs (subject to the terms of those plans or programs).

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. title: Product Lead - AI Neobank App
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Korea. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Korea.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Regional Supply Planner

title: Brand Motion Graphics Designer
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

WHO YOU ARE

We are seeking a talented and imaginative Brand Motion Graphics Designer to become a valuable part of our team. The ideal candidate should have a solid foundation in motion design with hands-on experience across modern design applications and production methods. They should be a technically minded individual who can adopt new applications easily and has a basic understanding of coding and scripting. This role requires a passion for visual storytelling, and the ability to bring ideas to life through motion graphics and video editing.

Join our creative and enthusiastic team, where your innovative ideas will help shape our brand's digital identity and drive impactful marketing initiatives. We look forward to meeting you!

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design and create engaging motion graphics for a wide range of projects, including but not limited to promotional videos, event stage graphics, social media content, product demonstrations, and visual effects.

  • Streamline the production process by developing, utilizing, and maintaining Premiere templates (MOGRTs) that reduce turnaround times and ensure visual cohesion across all collaborative projects.

  • Manage day-to-day production of motion assets within established timelines and brand guidelines.

  • Partner with Video Editors to weave motion design into live-action footage, ensuring that graphics and effects complement the narrative and enhance the overall quality of the edit.

  • Utilize Adobe applications to edit and assemble compelling assets that align with the project's objectives and target audience.

  • Integrate generative AI workflows to accelerate conceptual exploration and automate technical tasks, allowing for faster iteration without sacrificing brand integrity.

  • Support motion projects with sound design, layering music, sound effects, and voiceovers with guidance from senior creatives.

  • Assist in exploring new motion formats (e.g., web experiences, data visualizations) alongside senior team members.

  • Demonstrate proficiency in 3D software (e.g., Cinema 4D or Blender) to create 3D graphics and animations.

  • Collaborate with others on the Brand & Creative team to develop strong visual narratives that effectively communicate key messages and emotions.

  • Perform color grading and finishing to ensure visual assets are polished and consistent with brand standards.

  • Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends, techniques, and technologies to consistently improve and innovate motion graphics, video editing, and sound editing practices.

  • Contribute to and help maintain a library of graphic elements, templates, and project files to streamline workflow and optimize collaboration.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to incorporate feedback and ensure motion assets align with project objectives and brand standards.

  • Seek and incorporate feedback from senior designers and creative leads to continuously improve quality of output.

WHAT YOU’LL HAVE

  • Strong understanding of animation principles, including timing, easing, and visual rhythm to create polished motion work.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, specifically After Effects and Premiere. Familiarity with file optimization and render management best practices.

  • Ability to incorporate video and audio elements into animation projects, enhancing the overall audio-visual experience.

  • Strong visual storytelling abilities, with the skill to translate creative briefs into storyboards and style frames with direction from senior creatives.

  • Technically oriented and forward-thinking mindset with a curiosity and willingness to explore AI-assisted tools to optimize workflows.

  • Strong communication skills. You can clearly present your work and incorporate feedback constructively.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EDUCATION

  • 2-4 years in motion graphics design, video editing, and sound editing, with a diverse portfolio showcasing your capabilities and versatility.

  • Proficiency in Adobe applications and an expert of Adobe After Effects and Premiere, with a strong understanding of their functionalities and integration for seamless workflows.

  • Proficient in creating 3D graphics and animations using software like Cinema 4D, or Blender.

title: Investigator
description:
ABOUT US: Ethos Risk Services is a leading insurance claims investigation and medical management company, specializing in surveillance and fraud detection. At the forefront, we provide accurate data and actionable insights that translate into better decision-making for our clients.

JOB SUMMARY:

Our dynamic Ethos team is seeking an Experienced Field Investigator to conduct surveillance and investigative activities to identify potential fraudulent insurance claims. This role involves performing both stationary and mobile surveillance, obtaining video and photographic evidence, and preparing thorough, detailed reports for clients.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Case Preparation: Prepare for surveillance assignment by reviewing Ethos' preliminary reports and case information.
  • Field Surveillance: Perform covert surveillance from your vehicle by tracking and capturing high-quality video evidence of surveillance targets.
  • Report Writing: Draft detailed and court-ready investigative reports summarizing activity and key findings.
  • Documentation: Finalize case file by submitting case reports and uploading video footage via personal laptop at the end of the day.
  • Communication: Work closely with the field supervisor and operations teams, receiving regular guidance and mentorship.


REQUIREMENTS:

  • Previous Experience: Demonstrated proficiency in covert surveillance techniques, capturing high-quality video footage, and preparing thorough, well-organized investigative reports.
  • Driver's License: Valid driver's license and proof of automobile insurance.
  • Personal Vehicle: A well-maintained vehicle that is always reliable (preferably with tinted windows).
  • Surveillance Equipment: A handheld camcorder with high-quality zoom and a covert camera device. Use of stabilization equipment (gimbals, tripods, etc.) is strongly encouraged.
  • Technology: A reliable laptop, cell phone, and internet service are needed for communication and administrative tasks.
  • Private Investigator License: Active Private Investigator license or willingness to obtain one (where required by state).


WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • While we aim to keep assignments within a 2-hour drive of your residence, occasional further travel and overnight stays (covered by the company) may be required
  • Most surveillance cases start at 6:00AM. End time can vary depending on activity and a typical workday can vary from 3-12 hours.
  • Weekends/holidays are common workdays as claimants are more likely to be active.
  • This is an independent role often requiring long hours alone in your vehicle, regardless of weather conditions.
  • Must remain alert with no external distractions, ready to use videography equipment to document subjects.

title: Software Development Engineer - AI Frameworks, GPU SW Performance
description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career.




THE ROLE:
AMD is looking for a world class AI frameworks engineer who can provide technical leadership in the development of various AI frameworks in the AMD ecosystem. You will play a pivotal role in developing and optimizing deep learning frameworks for AMD GPUs. You will engage with both internal GPU library teams and open-source maintainers to ensure seamless integration of optimizations, utilizing cutting-edge compiler technologies and advanced engineering principles to drive continuous improvement.

THE PERSON:
If you are passionate about AI/ML frameworks, software architecture, and/or compilers this is your opportunity. You will be working in one of the core areas, such as AI/ML frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, vLLM, SGLang), AI runtime components, and/or optimization tooling to accelerate AI/ML workloads on AMD GPUs. You will collaborate closely with AI researchers to drive the development of framework components to efficiently map AI models to run on latest AMD GPUs. You should be someone who can work in a dynamic development environment, with excellent leadership and collaboration skills. You will work with multiple engineering teams that are geographically dispersed. You will work on next generation framework software, guiding other senior developers and domain experts.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Optimize Deep Learning Frameworks: Enhance and optimize frameworks like PyTorch, vLLM, SGLang for AMD GPUs in open-source repositories.
  • Develop GPU Kernels: Create and optimize GPU kernels to maximize performance for specific AI operations.
  • Develop & Optimize Models: Design and optimize deep learning models using quantization specifically for AMD GPU performance.
  • Collaborate with GPU Library Teams: Work closely with internal teams to analyze and improve training and inference performance on AMD GPUs.
  • Collaborate with Open-Source Maintainers: Engage with framework maintainers to ensure code changes are aligned with requirements and integrated upstream.
  • Software Engineering Best Practices: Apply sound engineering principles to ensure robust, maintainable solutions.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • GPU Kernel Development & Optimization: Experienced in designing and optimizing GPU kernels for deep learning on AMD GPUs using HIP, CUDA, and assembly (ASM). Strong knowledge of AMD architectures (GCN, RDNA) and low-level programming to maximize performance for AI operations, leveraging tools like Compute Kernel (CK), CUTLASS, and Triton for multi-GPU and multi-platform performance.
  • Experience with AI software framework, such as PyTorch, vLLM, SGLang, benchmarking and profiling.
  • Experience using profiling and benchmark tooling for large models.
  • Experience with model optimization, such as low-precision quantization (MXFP4, FP8, INT4), sparsity.
  • Solid understanding of model architectures, LLMs, MoE, diffusion.
  • Proficient in C++ programming.
  • Experience developing and debugging in Python.
  • Team player and ready to work with a geographically distributed team.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

BS, MS or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical fields.
