title: Founder's Office
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for high-ownership generalists to join the Founder's Office for BJAK's finance super app expansion. This role is for builders who can take on ambiguous business problems, move fast across functions and help launch new financial products, markets, licences and partnerships.

What You'll Own

  • Drive zero-to-one strategic projects for the finance super app.

  • Support licensing, market entry, partner acquisition, office setup, hiring and operating plans.

  • Research markets, competitors, regulations, partners and business models.

  • Turn founder-level ideas into structured plans, owners, timelines and next actions.

  • Work across product, legal, compliance, finance, hiring, operations and country teams.

  • Build trackers, briefs, memos, operating documents and execution rhythms.

  • Own urgent business problems until they are solved.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong generalist with high ownership, strong writing and sharp business judgement.

  • Able to learn new industries, regulations and markets quickly.

  • Comfortable working on licensing, partnerships, operations, market research and execution.

  • Can turn messy inputs into clear plans and follow-through.

  • Fast, resourceful and calm under pressure.

  • Strong English communication and structured thinking.

  • Experience in startups, consulting, fintech, strategy, operations, investing or founder-led environments is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Finds a way without waiting for a full playbook.

  • Can work with senior leaders and still do hands-on execution.

  • Writes clearly, thinks practically and follows up relentlessly. Handles ambiguity without creating drama.

  • Cares about real outcomes, not looking important.


This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want strategy decks.

  • Candidates who need fixed job scope and predictable tasks.

  • People who avoid follow-up, admin details or operational work.

  • Those who cannot write clearly or move fast.

  • People who want title/status more than responsibility.


Location

This role is based in Japan. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Japan office at least 3 days per week.

Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.


Interview Process:

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Knives, Grinders, Patty Maker, Tenderizer, Slicer, Pallet jack, Tumbler, Wrapping system, and Rotisserie.

Deals with customers on a daily basis and vendors/suppliers on an as needed basis.

title: Senior Producer (Pillar) | Producteur(trice) principal(e) (Pilier)
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Senior Producer (Pillar) in AAA game development to support delivery across a large-scale project. You will partner closely with the Product Owner, and pod leads to translating priorities into clear plans, facilitating key Scrum rituals, removing blockers, managing dependencies, and supporting team health across the pillar.

This role combines game production experience, agile facilitation, and day-to-day team leadership. You will help create a collaborative, transparent, and accountable environment where teams can deliver high-quality work with focus and clarity. If it sounds like you, we’d love to meet you!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Translate pillar priorities into sprint plans, team commitments, and clear delivery expectations.
  • Facilitate planning, refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and cross-pod coordination rituals.
  • Maintain visibility on progress, risks, dependencies, capacity, and delivery confidence.
  • Keep backlogs clear, prioritized, and actionable in partnership with the Product Owner, pod leads, and craft directors.
  • Identify blockers early and help teams resolve or escalate them effectively.
  • Support communication across pods so teams have the context they need to make decisions.
  • Improve workflows, rituals, and delivery habits through retrospectives and team feedback.
  • Coordinate execution against production pipelines, milestones, and broader project goals.
  • Reinforce a culture of collaboration, transparency, ownership, adaptability, and shared responsibility for quality.

Nous recherchons un(e) Senior Producer expérimenté(e) (Pilier), dans le développement de jeux AAA afin de soutenir la livraison d’un projet à grande échelle. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec le Product Owner et les leads de pods afin de traduire les priorités en plans clairs, d’animer les principaux rituels Scrum, de lever les blocages, de gérer les dépendances et de soutenir la santé des équipes au sein du pilier.

Ce rôle combine une expérience en production de jeux, en facilitation agile et en leadership opérationnel au quotidien. Vous contribuerez à créer un environnement collaboratif, transparent et responsable, où les équipes peuvent livrer un travail de haute qualité avec concentration et clarté. Si ce poste vous correspond, nous serions ravis de vous rencontrer !

Responsabilités Principales:

  • Traduire les priorités du pilier en plans de sprint, engagements des équipes et attentes de livraison claires.
  • Animer les rituels agiles clés : planification, refinement, revues, rétrospectives et coordination inter‑pods.
  • Maintenir une visibilité sur l’avancement, les risques, les dépendances, la capacité et le niveau de confiance de la livraison.
  • Maintenir des backlogs clairs, priorisés et exploitables en partenariat avec le Product Owner, les leads de pods et les directeurs de discipline.
  • Identifier les blocages en amont et aider les équipes à les résoudre ou à les escalader efficacement.
  • Soutenir la communication entre les pods afin que les équipes disposent du contexte nécessaire à la prise de décision.
  • Améliorer les flux de travail, les rituels et les habitudes de livraison grâce aux rétrospectives et aux retours des équipes.
  • Coordonner l’exécution en lien avec les pipelines de production, les jalons et les objectifs globaux du projet.
  • Renforcer une culture de collaboration, de transparence, de responsabilisation, d’adaptabilité et de responsabilité collective en matière de qualité.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in AAA game production, content production, asset production, or related production roles. Proven experience in game production, ideally on complex AAA or large-scale projects.
  • Experience operating as a Scrum Master, agile producer, delivery lead, or senior producer supporting multiple teams.
  • Strong understanding of Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid production approaches.
  • Ability to partner effectively with Product Owners, pod leads, craft directors, and multidisciplinary development teams.
  • Strong facilitation skills, with the ability to run productive meetings, clarify decisions, and drive alignment.
  • Experience with sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives, risk tracking, dependency management, and delivery follow-up.
  • Experience with milestone planning, sprint execution, production gates, and hybrid agile models.
  • Ability to manage cross-team dependencies, identify risks early, and create transparency around delivery confidence.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage ambiguity and help teams break complex goals into executable plans.
  • Experience working with JIRA or similar project management tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trust and support a positive, collaborative development culture.
  • Experience supporting multiple teams within a product area, pillar, or large-scale development initiative.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting multidisciplinary pods, feature teams, or cross-functional strike teams.
  • Scrum Master certification or formal agile training.
  • Experience with live service development, platform development, UGC systems, or large-scale online games.
  • Experience managing technical pipelines, scalable systems, cross team cross function dependencies.
  • Background in a development discipline such as design, engineering, art, QA, technical art, or production technology.
  • Experience working with external development partners, outsourcing teams, or co-development vendors.

Eligibility Requirements:

  • Interested candidates must apply to be considered.
  • Must be willing to work in our Montreal office a minimum of 4 days a week.
  • Must be willing to work overtime when required, in accordance with Quebec labor standards.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada.
  • Must be willing to travel for work related business, if necessary

Qualifications De Base:

  • Minimum de 10 ans d’expérience en production de jeux AAA, production de contenu, production d’assets ou dans des rôles de production équivalents. Expérience avérée en production de jeux, idéalement sur des projets AAA complexes ou à grande échelle.
  • Expérience en tant que Scrum Master, producer agile, responsable de la livraison ou senior producer accompagnant plusieurs équipes.
  • Bonne compréhension des approches de production Scrum, Kanban ou hybrides.
  • Capacité à collaborer efficacement avec les Product Owners, les leads de pods, les directeurs de discipline et des équipes de développement multidisciplinaires.
  • Solides compétences en facilitation, avec la capacité d’animer des réunions productives, de clarifier les décisions et de favoriser l’alignement.
  • Expérience en planification de sprints, refinement des backlogs, rétrospectives, suivi des risques, gestion des dépendances et suivi de la livraison.
  • Expérience en planification des jalons, exécution des sprints, étapes de production et modèles agiles hybrides.
  • Capacité à gérer les dépendances inter-équipes, à identifier les risques en amont et à assurer la transparence sur la confiance de livraison.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication, résolution de problèmes et collaboration.
  • Capacité à gérer l’ambiguïté et à aider les équipes à transformer des objectifs complexes en plans exécutables.
  • Expérience avec JIRA ou des outils de gestion de projet similaires.
  • Capacité démontrée à instaurer la confiance et à soutenir une culture de développement positive et collaborative.
  • Expérience en support de plusieurs équipes au sein d’un domaine produit, d’un pilier ou d’une initiative de développement à grande échelle.

Qualifications Souhaitées:

  • Expérience en support de pods multidisciplinaires, d’équipes feature ou d’équipes transverses (strike teams).
  • Certification Scrum Master ou formation formelle en méthodes agiles.
  • Expérience en développement de live service, développement de plateformes, systèmes UGC ou jeux en ligne à grande échelle.
  • Expérience dans la gestion de pipelines techniques, de systèmes scalables et de dépendances inter-équipes et inter-fonctionnelles.
  • Formation ou expérience dans une discipline de développement telle que le design, l’ingénierie, l’art, le QA, l’art technique ou la technologie de production.
  • Expérience de collaboration avec des partenaires de développement externes, des équipes d’externalisation ou des prestataires en co-développement.

Exigences D’admissibilité:

  • Les personnes intéressées doivent soumettre leur candidature afin d’être considérées.
  • Doit être disposé·e à travailler dans nos bureaux de Montréal au minimum quatre (4) jours par semaine.
  • Doit être disposé·e à effectuer des heures supplémentaires lorsque requis, conformément aux normes du travail du Québec.
  • Doit être légalement autorisé·e à travailler au Canada.
  • Doit être disposé·e à se déplacer pour des raisons professionnelles, au besoin.

title: Distribution & Recycling Associate
description:
Who We Are

For more than 130 years, The Salvation Army has served people in need in communities across Canada and Bermuda. Building on our roots as a world-wide Christian church, each year we help more than 2 million people, providing necessities such as food, clothing and shelter. In addition, we support people experiencing unemployment, addiction and family challenges. We continually adapt and innovate to meet emerging needs and live out our mission, vision and values of hope, service, dignity and stewardship. As a faith- and values-based organization, we hire and serve people of all backgrounds and walks of life - there is a place for everyone to belong here.

Mission Statement

The Salvation Army exists to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in the communities of our world.

Job Description:

POSITION PURPOSE SUMMARY:
The role will be responsible for standard warehouse duties of receiving, sorting, putting away, picking and shipping of various donations, primarily goods and food products for a great cause. Regular power equipment (forklift, power cart) use is required as well as a significant amount of manual work and use of computer systems to help supply donated goods to member agencies who help the needy in our communities.

ACCOUNTABILITIES:
The incumbent may perform all, some, or similar range of duties.

Warehouse:
• Perform shipping and receiving of goods.
• Loading and off-loading of trucks using powered and manual MHE.
• Operate various types of forklifts to move and store goods in warehouse according to warehouse layout plan.
• Inspect goods received for quality, damage, expiry (use-by) dates; document, rotate, and store stock appropriately to ensure maximum yield is achieved.
• Build skids of fresh, frozen and/or dry goods for delivery.
• Sort and categorize food and non-food items.
• Accurately count and weigh product being delivered or shipped.
• Assist with inventory reconciliation (cycle counting).
• Use Warehouse Management System/Inventory Management System to record and facilitate warehouse operations.
• Perform general cleaning and Maintenance: tasks of warehouse, yard, and equipment as required.
• Inspect powered and manual material handling equipment to ensure safe use.
• Replenish/put away materials utilizing reach truck to navigate narrow aisles.
• Order planning and order release tasks as required.

General:
• Promote the Mission, Policies and Objectives of the Ontario Distribution Centre
• Prepare, complete and submit documentation in a timely manner as required.
• Maintain a clean and organized work environment.
• Adhere to the Salvation Army Policy & Procedures and Health & Safety Guidelines.
• Wear the appropriate safety and Personal Protective Equipment and maintain a clean uniform.
• Ensure all work is completed in a safe manner, in accordance with TSA, WSIB, CVOR, and all other regulatory requirements.
• Performs other work-related duties as assigned.

CRITICAL RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT:
• Conducts Routine Interactions. Routine information.
• Internal: Work cooperatively with Supply Chain Warehouse Manager/Workers, Drivers, and volunteers
• External: Interact courteously and professionally with suppliers and donors

MANAGERIAL/TECHNICAL RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Reports directly to the DRC Manager.
• Direct reports: None.

FINANCIAL AND MATERIAL MANAGEMENT:
• Moderate financial responsibility:
• Accountable for operating and inspecting specialized equipment to sort, transport, store, and build skids.
• Accountable for the efficient/effective handling of goods and materials and the responsibility for distributing products to the various clients, considering warehouse stock, product best before dates, and client needs.
• Uses or maintains organization assets in accordance with established guidelines.
• Does not process any financial transactions with no budget responsibilities.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

• This is a permanent full-time position.
• Work is typically performed in a warehouse environment with exposure to handling garbage, monotony of work (repetitive tasks), various odours.
• Work involves regular work in freezers and refrigerators with some outdoor work in winter.
• Sustained heavy labour or working in cramped positions over considerable periods. May on occasion be required to lift, move, or transport weights up to 50 lbs but regular weights would normally fall under 40 lbs.

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:
• Willingness to develop an understanding and support for the mission and purpose of The Salvation Army in Canada and its implications as related to position responsibilities.
• Work in compliance with OH&S Act and Regulations and abide by The Salvation Army’s health and safety policies and procedures.
• Alternative combination of education and Experience may be considered.

Education, Qualifications and Certifications:
• Completion of some High School
• Current Forklift Operators Certificate

Experience and Knowledge:
• More than 6 months of related experience in a store or warehouse environment.

Skills and Capabilities:
• Proven attention to detail and the ability to follow legislation, directions, policies, procedures and well-defined steps.
• Ability to safely lift up to 50 pounds.
• Reliable, self-motivated, and confident.
• Ability to work in a team setting as well as independently.
• Good communication skills, both verbal and written.
• Able to adopt a flexible work schedule during peak and/or seasonal times.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to perform several tasks concurrently with ease and professionalism.
• Ability to understand and adhere to the Code of Ethics.
• Able to work in a consultative, diplomatic and tactful manner.
• Organizational and time-management skills to plan and manage the workload.
• Acceptable criminal record check.

• Ability to undergo applicable screening and background checks successfully that are satisfactory to The Salvation Army, in its sole discretion.

Compensation:

The target hiring range for this position is $17.60 to $21.03 with a maximum of $25.23.

Placement in the salary range will be based on factors such as market conditions, internal equity, and candidate experience, skills, and qualifications relevant to the role.

The Salvation Army will provide reasonable accommodation upon request. Please email Recruitment.Accommodations@salvationarmy.ca if you have a need for any accommodation and we will be pleased to discuss this with you.

title: Purchaser
description:
Fourway Engineering Pte Ltd is an ISO certified company which specialized in the design and manufacturing of Electrical Switchboard, Smart Panel, ACMV Panel, LCP and all types of customized empty metal enclosures.

title: Beauty Therapist
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Beauty Therapist is responsible for delivering high‑quality waxing, skincare, and spa treatments while ensuring exceptional guest care and safety. This role includes assessing guest needs, identifying contraindications, recommending appropriate treatments, and promoting home‑care products. The Beauty Therapist maintains treatment rooms, adheres to hygiene and safety protocols, and supports overall spa operations by maintaining professionalism and service excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide professional beauty and spa treatments, including waxing and skincare services, in accordance with brand standards and guest needs.
  • Conduct thorough consultations by assessing skin condition, identifying contraindications, and determining the most suitable treatment options.
  • Educate guests on proper skincare routines and recommend appropriate retail products and home‑care regimens.
  • Promote and sell spa services and retail offerings to enhance guest wellbeing and drive revenue.
  • Escort guests to and from treatment rooms, ensuring comfort, privacy, and a seamless spa experience.
  • Prepare and maintain clean, well‑organized treatment rooms by setting up equipment, products, and supplies before each service.
  • Clean, sanitize, and properly store all tools and equipment to meet health and safety standards.
  • Adhere to scheduled treatment times, manage appointments efficiently, and maintain accurate service records.
  • Professionally manage inappropriate guest behavior by ceasing the service and informing the supervisor/manager immediately.
  • Follow all company policies, safety procedures, and confidentiality guidelines, and complete required training and certifications.
  • Maintain professional grooming, communication, and conduct; support teamwork and uphold quality standards.
  • Perform other reasonable duties as assigned by Supervisors.

Qualifications & Experience

Required:

  • Diploma in Beauty & Spa Therapy or equivalent formal training.

Preferred:

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in a spa, salon, or beauty therapy environment.
  • Strong knowledge of skincare, waxing techniques, and professional beauty products.
  • Excellent consultation and communication skills with the ability to build guest trust.
  • Ability to maintain high hygiene standards and follow safety protocols.
  • Strong customer‑service mindset, sales ability, and a warm, professional personality.
  • Must have legal working rights in Fiji.

This role is island‑based and requires working on a rostered stay‑on‑island schedule.

title: Senior Director, Data Center Reliability Engineering (Nashville, TN)
description:
The Senior Director of Operational Reliability, Data Centers, is a critical leadership role responsible for ensuring the consistent, compliant, and reliable operation of all Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) infrastructure across Oracle’s global data center fleet. This position has overall accountability for MEP maintenance in accordance with Oracle’s stringent standards and Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) requirements, while also partnering collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders to drive industry-leading operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities:

  • MEP Infrastructure Maintenance:
    Lead the oversight and execution of preventive and corrective maintenance programs for all data center MEP assets, ensuring compliance with Oracle and OEM guidelines.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    Work closely with Vendor Management and Engineering teams to ensure appropriate equipment selection, timely adoption of OEM bulletins, and mitigation of potential risks.
  • Service Delivery & Validation:
    Oversee SCCS (System Capacity and Compliance Studies) and validate service delivery plans to assure operational capacity and readiness.
  • End-of-Life Planning & Quality Assurance:
    Guide end-of-life (EOL) strategies, ensuring thorough quality assurance reviews with Engineering and oversight of service development needs for equipment retirement and refresh projects.
  • Day 2 Operations Management:
    Proactively address ‘day 2’ operational issues to prevent potential impacts on critical IT load, ensuring business continuity.
  • Incident Management:
    Serve as escalation point and leader for incident response, overseeing tier 2 technical support for field teams and supporting the build-out, integration, and monitoring of Facility Operations Centers across the Oracle data center fleet.
  • Building Automation & Centralized Services:
    Lead the Building Automation Operations organization and centralized service functions to ensure consistent operational standards and rapid response across all facilities.
  • Continuous Improvement:
    Institute best practices, foster a culture of safety, compliance, and innovation, and drive ongoing improvements in operational reliability and performance metrics.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, or related field (Master’s preferred). Or equivelent education and experience.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in data center, critical environment operations, or facilities management roles, with significant leadership responsibility.
  • Deep technical knowledge of MEP systems and infrastructure maintenance, including adherence to regulatory and OEM standards.
  • Demonstrated experience with service delivery planning, incident management, and cross-disciplinary team leadership.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.
  • Experience developing and managing building automation and centralized monitoring systems (BMS, SCADA, CMMS).
  • Excellent oral and written communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Proven record of vendor management and contract oversight.

Preferred Attributes:

  • Professional certifications such as CFM, PMP, LEED AP, or equivalent.
  • Experience in large-scale, mission-critical infrastructure environments.
  • Strong understanding of risk management, quality assurance, and end-of-life asset strategies.

title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
description:
The Java Platform Group is looking for an experienced, passionate, and highly motivated Software Engineer to join our world class development efforts. Our team is responsible for delivering and testing the Java platform that is used by millions of developers. We are looking for a seasoned engineer with a strong Java programming background and a desire to make a positive change in our product.

We hire developers to write code to test code. Our goal is to have engineers writing well designed, robust, reliable, repeatable and maintainable open-source tests that find issues early and provide adequate coverage for the component under testing. title: Retail Key Holder
description:
WHO WE ARE:

Headquartered in Southern California, Skechers—the Comfort Technology Company®—has spent over 30 years helping men, women, and kids everywhere look and feel good. Comfort innovation is at the core of everything we do, driving the development of stylish, high-quality products at a great value. From our diverse footwear collections to our expanding range of apparel and accessories, Skechers is a complete lifestyle brand.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Key Holder, better known as a “Floor Leader,” at Skechers, you’ll take on an essential Retail Leadership Role, contributing to store operations and mentoring your team to deliver exceptional customer service. In this entry-level management role, you’ll oversee daily operations, support sales goals, and help maintain the store's premium shopping environment. Whether you're looking to advance your Retail Manager career, refine your skills as a Key Holder, or grow into a Retail Management role, this opportunity offers room to thrive within the Skechers global brand.

COMPENSATION RATE

STARTING RATE: $19.67

HOURLY RANGE: $19.67 - $20.87

BENEFIT HIGHLIGHTS:

  • Competitive pay with regular increases.
  • Generous discounts on Skechers footwear, apparel, and accessories (including exclusive Friends and Family discounts!).
  • Flexible schedules to support work-life balance.
  • On-the-job training to strengthen skills in Retail Leadership Roles, Customer Service Management, and store operations.
  • Opportunities for career advancement in Retail Management with a global brand like Skechers.
  • Additional Benefits & Perks to be reviewed during the interview process.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Customer Service Management: Engage with customers to deliver expert advice on Skechers products, ensuring every shopper leaves with the perfect fit and great experience.
  • Retail Leadership Role: Supervise daily operations, including store opening and closing procedures as required, ensuring security protocols and excellent operational standards.
  • Team Leadership: Mentor and support team members to grow their skills in entry-level retail that include customer service, sales, and daily operations.
  • Sales and Goals: Actively contribute to achieving store and individual sales targets by implementing effective selling techniques and promoting key Skechers products.
  • Store Operations: Execute merchandising plans, restock products, and maintain store cleanliness to enhance the shopping environment.
  • Retail Supervisor Duties: Oversee stock and inventory routines while collaborating with store management to address operational needs.
  • Problem Solving: Proactively identify and resolve in-store challenges to ensure a smooth shopping experience for customers.

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU:

  • Ability to work a varied schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • Problem solving skills to resolve any issues that may arise in-store.
  • Highly organized to manage inventory, staffing, and other operational tasks.
  • Ability and desire to foster a respectful, safe, and fun environment for Skechers store employees.
  • Comfortable mentoring team members and communicating with all levels of the store team.
  • Acts with a sense of confidentiality and urgency.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred but not required.
  • Previous experience as a Key Holder, Shift Leader, or Retail Supervisor in retail, restaurant, or hospitality industry is preferred but not required.
  • Sales skills to drive revenue growth and meet targets.
  • Excellent communication skills in written, verbal and interpersonal skills.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age at time of application.

Step into your next retail career with Skechers!

Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

title: Product Partnerships, Find My
description:
The Find My team is dedicated to building a seamless, private, and secure experience for users to locate their devices, personal items, and share location with friends and family. We’re a group of highly motivated engineers, designers, and product managers who are passionate about creating a simple and reliable experience for hundreds of millions of users worldwide. Innovation and creative problem-solving are at the heart of our team, and we constantly explore new approaches to deliver groundbreaking solutions while collaborating with diverse disciplines across the company, including hardware, software, and privacy, to craft an exceptional user experience.

As a Product Partnerships Manager, on our team, you'll thrive in a fast-paced, startup-like environment, collaborating closely with a passionate cross-functional team spanning engineering, design, marketing, and public relations to drive both the development and launch of our shared mission. You'll be instrumental in shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and bringing exciting new features to third-party manufacturers, and your vision will directly impact millions of users. We embrace continuous iteration and improvement, so you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and sharpen your skills across the full product lifecycle as we build the future of Find My.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7+ years experience in product marketing, product management, and/or product partnership roles, including at least one entire product development cycle from concept to launch.
  • Hands-on experience formulating product messaging and creating outbound marketing for both technical and consumer audiences.
  • Proven ability to partner with engineering and design to define product strategy and roadmap, and with marketing and public relations to craft positioning, and define key marketing activities.
  • Ability to drive communication with key stakeholders, the media, and public, as demonstrated by exceptional presentation skills: developing keynote addresses in an area of deep subject matter expertise, synthesizing information, applying critical thinking, crafting a compelling product story, and maintaining composure under pressure.
  • Strong empathy for users and the ability to reason through product trade-offs.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, ability to track many moving parts at once.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; comfortable engaging with technical and executive audiences alike.
  • Experience with managing multiple concurrent projects with rapidly changing information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in product management, product marketing, and/or product partnership roles
  • Experience or strong interest in products involving user privacy, security, or location-based technologies.
  • A self-starter who is dedicated and demonstrates creative and critical thinking abilities.
  • Well-versed in formulating product messaging including creating and delivering outbound marketing.
  • Passion for product quality, user experience design, and attention to detail.
  • Bachelor’s and/or master’s degree, or MBA preferred.

title: Project Coordinator/Inside Sales - Applied
description:
Since 1971, CFM Company has been delivering high-performance HVAC and sheet metal solutions across Colorado and Eastern Wyoming. We represent top-tier manufacturers and support our customers through every stage—from system design and selection to logistics, installation, and beyond. Our team is built on relationships, driven by service, and committed to doing the job right.

If you're ready for what's next, we’re excited you found us. At CFM, you’ll be part of a company that combines deep local roots with the backing of a national network—giving you the tools to grow, the freedom to take on new challenges, and the chance to make a lasting impact in the communities we serve. We review every application carefully and appreciate your interest in growing your career with our team.

The Project Coordinator / Inside Sales role is a key support function within the sales organization, responsible for driving accuracy and execution across the HVAC project lifecycle.
This position supports outside sales teams by managing estimating, quoting, submittals, and order coordination while maintaining strong communication with contractors and manufacturers. The role directly contributes to successful bid outcomes and project delivery. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced construction-driven environment where deadlines, accuracy, and communication are critical.

Base Compensation:
 $22.00/ hr. - $46.00/hr.

Level 1 – Entry (0–2 years)

Scope: Basic take-offs, quoting support, order entry, guided estimating support, and project tracking.

Level 2 – Developing (2–5 years)

Scope: Independent estimating, submittals, contractor interaction, full project support ownership.

Level 3 – Advanced (5+ years)

Scope: Complex estimating, bid strategy support, manufacturer coordination, high-level project execution.

Key Responsibilities

Sales & Project Support

  • Assisting outside sales in supporting contractor bids and project opportunities
  • Perform HVAC take-offs, estimating, and product selection/pricing
  • Prepare quotations, proposals, and submittals
  • Enter and manage customer orders and project documentation
  • Maintain project logs and ensure accurate job tracking

Project Execution & Coordination

  • Track shipments, deliveries, and project milestones
  • Enter and maintain project details in Company ERP tool
  • Coordinate Start-Up with internal Company Service department and external Service teams
  • Coordinate warranty documentation and O&M manuals (IOMs)
  • Support billing documentation and project closeout requirements
  • Ensure timely follow-up on open project items

Customer & Manufacturer Communication

  • Communicate with contractors, engineers, and internal sales teams
  • Develop strong working relationships with manufacturers as a product liaison
  • Support customer inquiries with timely and accurate responses
  • Participate in meetings, training sessions, and occasional site visits

Operational Excellence

  • Maintain accuracy and organization across all project documentation
  • Utilize estimating and productivity tools including Bluebeam Revu and Microsoft Office
  • Follow company policies and maintain professional standards
  • Support continuous improvement of internal processes and workflows

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent plus 2+ years of relevant experience, OR
  • Bachelor’s degree plus 1+ year of relevant experience
  • Experience in construction, HVAC, mechanical contracting, or distribution preferred
  • Familiarity with estimating, take-offs, quoting, or project coordination
  • Strong organizational skills with ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

Technical Skills

  • Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook)
  • Bluebeam Revu or similar take-off software
  • Manufacturer quoting or ordering systems (preferred)
  • General understanding of HVAC systems and equipment (preferred)

title: In-House Audio Engineer / Producer (Summit Music Group)
location: North Palm Beach, Florida, United States
description:
In-House Audio Engineer / Producer

Location: Palm Beach
Company: Summit Music Group


About Summit Music Group

Summit Music Group is a growing music company focused on artist development, production, recording, and long-term catalog creation. Founded and led by a Berklee College of Music Business alum with 15+ years of industry experience, Summit combines creative excellence with a long-term vision for building artists, sound, and intellectual property.

We are seeking a talented and versatile In-House Audio Engineer / Producer to join our creative team in Palm Beach, Florida. This role is ideal for an experienced music professional with a strong technical background in audio engineering, hands-on studio experience, and the ability to work across multiple music genres.


Role Summary

This is a hybrid creative and technical role responsible for producing records, engineering sessions, and helping shape Summit’s in-house sound and artist development process. The ideal candidate is highly organized, artist-friendly, collaborative, and passionate about creating release-ready music at a professional level.


Key Responsibilities

  • Engineer, record, edit, mix, and assist in mastering music projects
  • Produce and arrange tracks across multiple genres, including pop, hip-hop, R&B, rock, country, electronic, and alternative
  • Collaborate with artists, songwriters, and creative teams throughout the production process
  • Operate and maintain studio equipment, DAWs, plugins, microphones, and recording systems
  • Assist with vocal production, comping, tuning, and session organization
  • Support artist development, arrangement decisions, and creative direction
  • Maintain organized sessions, studio workflow, and professional quality standards
  • Contribute to the growth of Summit’s proprietary sound and long-term catalog value
  • Support live recording sessions and additional studio logistics as needed
  • Foster a collaborative, creative, and professional studio environment


Qualifications

  • 3–7+ years of professional audio engineering and/or music production experience preferred
  • Strong proficiency in Pro Tools, Logic Pro, Ableton, or similar DAWs
  • Experience working across multiple music genres
  • Strong understanding of recording signal flow, microphones, acoustics, and studio workflows
  • Musical training strongly preferred, especially piano/keyboard proficiency
  • Excellent communication, organization, and collaboration skills
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and work efficiently in a fast-paced creative environment
  • Audio engineering background preferred over beat-production-only experience
  • Strong creative instincts with a builder mindset and long-term vision


Preferred Experience

  • Experience working in professional recording studios
  • Knowledge of analog and digital recording equipment
  • Experience supporting artist development and songwriting collaboration
  • Familiarity with live sound or performance environments is a plus


Compensation & Structure

  • Flexible compensation structure based on experience
  • Options may include retainer, salary, or per-project compensation
  • Potential for production fees, master participation, and long-term growth opportunities tied to catalog development
  • Full-time preferred; flexible arrangements may be considered


Why Join Summit Music Group

  • Opportunity to help shape the sound and creative culture of an emerging music company
  • Collaborative environment focused on artist growth and high-quality production
  • Ground-floor opportunity with long-term upside potential
  • Work directly alongside a passionate and experienced music leadership team
  • Be part of building meaningful, lasting music assets and artist careers

Assigned shifts will likely include some combination of these time periods based on business needs, though schedules will vary and not all listed times will be required each week.

Client Growth & Management:

  • Manage and maintain an accurate schedule, inclusive of client appointments, meetings, and open availability within our internal scheduling systems
  • Grow your client base through exceptional coaching, relationship building, and proactive member engagement
  • Build a strong understanding of the Equinox ecosystem, confidently connecting clients with services that support their goals Professional Development & Compliance:
  • Consistently demonstrate behaviors aligned with the Equinox mission and values, creating the possibility for members and colleagues to maximize their potential through collaboration, accountability, and excellence • Deliver a high standard of coaching and service

title: Senior Full Stack .NET Engineer
description:
Sourceability is building a new Global Engineering Organization (GEO) to strengthen internal software delivery, improve production ownership, and build long-term engineering capability inside the company.

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack .NET Engineer to help design, build, maintain, and improve business-critical internal software platforms. This role will work across backend services, frontend applications, APIs, integrations, databases, testing, and production support.

This is a hands-on engineering role working hybrid from our Singapore office. The engineer will work closely with Product / Delivery Managers, Product Group Team Leads / Architects, QA, DevOps, DBA, Infrastructure, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable software changes and support production systems.

The right candidate should be comfortable working with both new development and existing systems, including legacy code, complex business workflows, production defects, integrations, and technical debt.

Insight on Your Impact:

In this role, you will:

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack applications using .NET / C# on the backend and modern web technologies on the frontend.
  • Build and maintain APIs, services, integrations, user interfaces, background jobs, and data-driven application features.
  • Work with SQL Server-backed systems, including data access, query performance, stored procedures where applicable, and production data behavior.
  • Translate engineering-ready backlog items and acceptance criteria into practical, maintainable technical solutions.
  • Partner with Product / Delivery Managers to clarify requirements, edge cases, user workflows, and release expectations.
  • Partner with Product Group Team Leads / Architects on technical design, implementation approach, estimates, dependencies, and risks.
  • Write clean, maintainable, testable, and well-documented code that follows GEO engineering standards.
  • Participate in code reviews and provide practical feedback to improve quality, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Write and maintain automated tests where practical, including unit, integration, API, and UI tests depending on the system.
  • Support QA and Product / Delivery teams during defect triage, regression testing, UAT support, release readiness, and post-release validation.
  • Investigate and resolve production defects, performance issues, integration failures, and other business-impacting application problems.
  • Contribute to root cause analysis and corrective actions after production incidents or recurring defects.
  • Identify technical debt, maintainability risks, and areas where refactoring or modernization can reduce production risk.
  • Document important technical decisions, implementation notes, support procedures, and system behavior for future maintenance.
  • Mentor mid-level and junior engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, and practical engineering examples.

Your Qualifications, Your Influence:

To be successful in this role, you should have:

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience with strong hands-on experience in .NET / C# and ASP.NET Core or similar Microsoft-based backend technologies.
  • Strong frontend development experience using Angular; experience with other modern JavaScript / TypeScript frameworks (e.g., React, Vue.js) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript / TypeScript, browser behavior, API integration, and frontend application structure.
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining RESTful APIs and integrations with internal and external systems.
  • Strong experience with relational databases, especially SQL Server; PostgreSQL, MySQL, or other relational databases are also helpful.
  • Solid understanding of software design patterns, SOLID principles, object-oriented programming, testability, maintainability, and secure coding practices.
  • Experience working with existing enterprise applications, production systems, legacy code, or complex business workflows.
  • Experience using Git-based workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and standard software development lifecycle practices.
  • Practical experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar systems for work tracking, backlog execution, code collaboration, and delivery visibility.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex application issues across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, integrations, and environments.
  • Ability to work independently in a distributed team while communicating clearly about progress, blockers, risks, and tradeoffs.
  • Strong ownership mindset and willingness to support production systems, not only write new code.

Preferred Skills and Technical Familiarity:

The following experience will be helpful in this role:

  • Experience with SourceCore-like enterprise platforms, ERP-adjacent systems, warehouse systems, sales / purchasing workflows, finance workflows, or B2B transaction platforms.
  • Experience with Azure cloud services, AWS, GCP, or hybrid cloud / on-prem environments.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized deployment models.
  • Experience with message queues, event-driven systems, background processing, scheduled jobs, or integration middleware.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with observability concepts such as logging, metrics, tracing, monitoring, alerting, and production diagnostics.
  • Experience improving legacy systems through safe refactoring, modernization, performance tuning, and technical debt reduction.
  • Experience in electronic components, technology distribution, supply chain, logistics, manufacturing, e-commerce, or similar B2B environments.
  • Interest in AI-assisted development tools and practical ways to improve engineering productivity and quality.

Success in the First 90 Days:

Within the first 90 days, the Senior Full Stack .NET Engineer should be able to:

  • Understand the assigned product group, key business workflows, architecture, codebase, integrations, databases, and production risks.
  • Become productive in the active engineering backlog and deliver meaningful software changes with appropriate quality.
  • Build working relationships with Product / Delivery Managers, Team Leads / Architects, QA, DevOps, DBA, Infrastructure, and other engineering team members.
  • Participate effectively in code reviews, technical discussions, defect triage, release readiness, and production issue investigation.
  • Identify practical improvements in code quality, maintainability, test coverage, performance, or production support.
  • Demonstrate strong ownership by communicating progress, blockers, risks, and dependencies clearly.
  • Contribute to at least one meaningful feature, stabilization effort, defect fix, integration improvement, or technical debt reduction activity.

What This Role Does Not Own:

This role does not own formal people management for other engineers. Engineering Managers remain responsible for hiring, performance management, compensation input, team structure, and capacity planning.

This role does not own business prioritization or user acceptance. Product / Delivery Managers and business stakeholders remain responsible for intake, priority alignment, backlog readiness, UAT coordination, and business acceptance.

This role does not independently make architecture decisions for the product group. Technical direction will be aligned with Product Group Team Leads / Architects, Engineering Managers, and GEO leadership.

This role does not independently commit delivery dates without alignment with Product / Delivery Managers and engineering leadership.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary
  • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities
  • Collaborative global work environment

title: First Nations Recovery Worker
description:
Wellways is committed to reconciliation, lived experience and inclusivity. We strongly encourage and warmly welcome people from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities, people with a lived experience of mental health and disability and people who identify as LGBTIQA+ to apply. Even if you only meet some of the criteria, we’d love to hear from you.

  • Support Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people through culturally safe, recovery-focused practice.
  • Build meaningful connections with families, communities and local services.
  • SCHADS Level 3 ($40.49 - $43.42 per hour) + Salary Packaging + Leave loading

First Nations Recovery Worker | Community Living Support (CLS)

Walk alongside people on their recovery journey while strengthening connection to culture, community and wellbeing.

At Wellways, we believe that recovery is possible for everyone. As a First Nations Recovery Worker, you will play a vital role in supporting Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people experiencing mental health challenges, psychological distress and/or substance use concerns to achieve their goals and live meaningful lives.

Community Living Support (CLS) is a NSW Government-funded program providing person-led, community-based psychosocial support for people aged 16 years and over living with severe mental health challenges. Working within a multidisciplinary team, you will provide culturally safe, recovery-oriented support that empowers participants to build independence, strengthen natural supports and reconnect with culture, family and community.

What you'll be doing

  • Provide practical, culturally safe and recovery-focused support to participants in the community.
  • Support people to identify their strengths, aspirations and goals and develop plans that support their recovery journey.
  • Build and strengthen connections with families, communities, services and cultural supports to promote wellbeing and belonging.

What you'll bring
You are passionate about supporting Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and understand the importance of culture, connection and self-determination in recovery. You bring strong communication and relationship-building skills, a collaborative approach to working within multidisciplinary teams, and the ability to provide practical support that promotes hope, healing and independence. You are confident maintaining accurate records and documentation and are comfortable travelling across the region.

Main responsibilities of the role include:

  • Support first nations participants to develop and work towards their recovery goals and aspirations.
  • Provide practical, strengths-based support that promotes independence and wellbeing.
  • Foster connections with Country, families, communities and natural support networks.
  • Complete recovery plans, assessments, file notes and program documentation.
  • Travel across the region to meet participant needs

You will also need:

  • Is acknowledged by First Nations community and leadership
  • Demonstrated strong connection with First Nations communities and demonstrated strong understanding of the lived experiences of First Nations communities on Country
  • Certificate IV/Diploma in Mental Health, AOD or tertiary qualification in social science or 1+ year relevant work experience in the Mental Health Sector or Intentional Peer Support Training
  • 100 points of identification and Birth Certificate/Passport
  • Drivers Licence
  • National Police Check
  • Working with Children Check and NDIS Workers Screening Check
  • NDIS Workers Orientation Modules – free online course

What we will offer you…

  • A purpose driven culture where people can thrive, everyone is respected, and differences are valued
  • An equitable, diverse, and socially inclusive work environment
  • Salary packaging up to $15,899 enables you to spend a portion of your salary before it is taxed to pay for things like rent, mortgage repayments, car leasing
  • Meal and Entertainment allowance via salary packaging up to $2,650 per annum
  • Receive 17.5% leave loading every time you take annual leave
  • Paid parental leave after 12 months of ongoing employment
  • Access for you and your family to our Employee Assistance Program

For a confidential discussion about the role, please contact Jenna Van Hees, Program Coordinator Jvanhees@wellways.org

Please ensure you submit your updated Resume along with a Cover Letter outlining your relevant experience.

To view the full Position Description and submit your application, click APPLY.

We encourage early applications as interviews may begin prior to advertising closing date.

Wellways is committed to the safeguarding of children and vulnerable people. Successful applicants must undergo a comprehensive screening process prior to their commencement.

Support recovery, culture and community as a First Nations Recovery Worker. Make a real difference through culturally safe, person-led support.

We’re passionate about our work, which is enjoyable, challenging and rewarding. All of our teams work to ensure everyone can imagine and achieve their hopes and potential.   • Identify common weeds and recommend methods for control
  • Coach and remind the team of the “Safety Topic” tailgate talk throughout the week/month
  • Assist the Crew Leader/Production Manager in coaching team members
  • Maintain a polite, friendly, responsive demeanor with guests and customers

Education and Experience:

  • At least 18 years old
  • Enthusiastic and dependable
  • Ability to safely work with equipment like power saws and cutters
  • Certified on level 3 equipment (bed edger, chainsaw, power pole, pruner, leaf vacuum, skid steer)
  • Certified to apply pesticides
  • Has demonstrated 6 months of accident-free performance

Physical Demands/Requirements:

  • Ability to lift and carry 40 lbs. (mulch, fertilizer, etc.)
  • Ability to load/unload burlaps with plant cuttings onto trailer (up to 50 lbs.)
  • Be at least 18 years old (21 if operating company provided vehicles)
  • Possess strong stamina and have the ability to work outdoors in various weather conditions including extreme heat and cold.
  • Able to safely operate landscaping equipment (e.g., mowers, trimmers, blowers, edgers).
  • Able to bend, stoop, kneel, twist, stand, walk continuously throughout the day and perform repetitive motions for extended periods.
  • Able to perform manual labor using a variety of hand tools (e.g. shovels, rakes)
  • You are able to wear appropriate personal protective equipment (e.g., safety shoes, high-visibility clothing, hand protection, eye protection, hearing protection, head protection)
  • Landscapers who will be operating a BrightView fleet vehicle are required to have a valid driver’s license and meet company standards as it relates motor vehicle performance identified on a state issued motor vehicle record check.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends or holidays if needed.
  • Ability to maintain, in your possession at all times, required medications to address any known allergic reactions should they occur.

Work Environment:

  • Ability to work outdoors/indoors in moderate to extreme weather conditions (e.g., temperatures more than 100°F, temperatures below 32°F, various levels of humidity)
  • Ability to work in direct sunlight for extended periods of time.
  • Work outdoors near automotive traffic, bodies of water, fumes, dust, mechanical and/or electrical hazards.
  • Ability to work in environments where extended periods of loud noise are present.
  • Ability to work in environments where exposure to allergens such as pollen and rag weed, insects such as bees and spiders and reptiles such as lizards and snakes.

BrightView Landscapes, LLC is an Equal Opportunity and E-Verify Employer.

This job description is subject to change at any time.

BrightView offers a suite or health, wellness, and financial benefits to full-time team members. Employees may also be eligible to receive paid time off for vacation and/or sick leave, tuition reimbursement, and/or potential variable pay opportunities based on position and performance. A detailed benefits package will be provided during the interview process.

It’s Not Just a Team. It’s One BrightView.

title: [커머스본부 제품팀] Product Designer (5~7년)
description:
About

유심사는 eSIM서비스로 여러분에게 더 가벼운 여행을 선물합니다.

스마트폰 시대가 어언 10년이 넘어갔습니다.
우리의 삶은 많이 바뀌었고 지금 이 순간도 새로운 기술들로 삶이 변화하고 있습니다.

하지만, 해외여행 할때 아직도 로밍/포켓와이파이 등 옛 기술들로 우리들의 여행이 가볍지 못했습니다.

포켓와이파이는 나의 짐이 무거워지고,
해외로밍서비스는 내 주머니가 가벼워집니다.

이런 문제를 유심사의 eSIM서비스가 해결합니다.

우리의 서비스로 고객들의 주머니는 무겁게. 여행할 때 짐은 가볍게!

한국인뿐만 아니라, 전세계 사람들을 대상으로 하는 유심사의 eSIM 서비스.
여행이 조금 더 즐거워집니다.

Responsibilities

유심사 프로덕트의 핵심 기능 및 사용자 경험 전반을 주도적으로 설계하는 프로덕트 디자이너를 채용합니다.
비즈니스 목표와 사용자 가치를 정밀하게 연결하며, 정량적·정성적 데이터 기반의 가설 검증을 통해 서비스의 지속적인 성장을 견인합니다.

1) 커머스 핵심 여정(End-to-End) UX/UI 설계 및 고도화
• 홈, 검색, 상품상세, 장바구니, 주문결제, 마이페이지 등 커머스 전반의 고객 경험 설계
• 사용자 경험 개선을 통한 핵심 지표(전환율, 매출, 리텐션 등) 향상 기여
• 구축된 디자인 시스템 및 스타일가이드 활용, 유지보수 및 운영
• 비즈니스 및 시스템 연계성을 고려한 구조화된 UX 설계
• A/B 테스트 등 실험 기반 UX 개선 설계 및 실행 참여

2) 프로덕트 협업 및 프로세스 참여
• 디자인 리뷰 참여 및 산출물 퀄리티 지속 개선
• 기획, 개발, 운영 전 과정에서의 적극적인 디자인 의견 개진 및 협업
• 사용자 데이터 및 피드백 기반 지속적인 개선 실행
• 스쿼드 기반 협업 주도
• 기획 초기 단계부터 Wireframe, User Flow, Prototype 등 명확한 산출물로 논리적 소통

Requirements

•5년 이상 7년 이하의 경력 또는 그에 준하는 역량 (커머스 또는 모바일 서비스 인하우스 경험 우대)
•프로덕트 디자인 역량을 포트폴리오로 증명할 수 있는 분
•주요 커머스 서비스의 핵심 라이프사이클(탐색~주문/결제)을 주도적으로 설계하고 시장에 출시하며 지속 개선해 본 경험이 있는 분
•데이터 기반으로 문제를 정의하고 실제 성과를 만들어본 경험이 있는 분
•디자인 시스템을 주도적으로 구축 및 운용하고 공통 컴포넌트 체계를 고도화해 본 역량이 있는 분
•Adobe, Figma, JIRA 능숙 활용
•Android / iOS / Web 플랫폼에 대한 기술적 이해도가 있는 분
•비즈니스 맥락과 기술 제약을 이해하고, 다양한 직군과 논리적인 커뮤니케이션이 가능하신 분

Preferred

•A/B 테스트 설계 및 실험 경험
•GA, 에어브릿지, Amplitude, Mixpanel 등 데이터 분석 활용 경험
•디자인 시스템 구축 또는 컴포넌트 운영 경험
•단일 기능이 아닌 서비스 확장 구조를 고민하고 설계해본 경험
•여행, 커머스, 이커머스 도메인 경험
•글로벌 서비스(다국어 UI) 설계 경험
•모션 디자인 또는 인터랙션 디자인 역량
•eSIM, 통신, 여행테크 도메인에 대한 이해
•AI 활용 경험

Benefits

• 자율 출퇴근제(08~10시 중 원하는 시간에 출근)
• 건강한 근무를 위한 종합 건강검진 지원
• 일과 휴식을 함께 즐길수 있는 워케이션 (연 최대 2회)
• 자사 제품은 언제든지 100% 무료이용 가능
• 복지용 법인카드 지원으로 커피 및 식사 이용 가능
• 다양한 연차사용(연차/반차/반반차)
• 생일자 조기퇴근

※ 각 복리후생마다 근속연수 기준에 따라 이용 가능 시점이 상이할 수 있음

title: Bilingual HR Advisor (Regional, QC and ON)
description:
Who We Are:
At Giant Tiger, our mission is simple: help Canadians save more every day. We’re a Canadian institution rooted in our communities and built on 60+ years of success. As part of our store support team, your work directly impacts stores across the country and drives the value that our customers see on the shelves.

We’re looking for people who are passionate about retail and motivated by meaningful work that makes a real impact. This posting represents a current opportunity at Giant Tiger.

Job Title

Bilingual HR Advisor (Regional, QC and ON)

About This Role:

Giant Tiger is looking for a fully Bilingual Human Resources Advisor to support a section of our Quebec and Ontario stores! This is a hybrid role that requires travel to our stores, so the ideal candidate would be located in or near Ottawa . When not traveling to our stores, the HR Advisor will choose to work where they work best. Due to many stores in this region being French-speaking only we do require the incumbent to be fully bilingual in English and French.

As an important member of the Store Human Resources team and reporting to the Manager, HRBP, the HR Advisor is responsible for supporting the Store Human Resources function, including all aspects of employee and labour relations, talent management and Human Resources Best Practices. The HR Advisor conducts regular store visits to review Store engagement and identifies any employee relations issues and escalates/resolves those issues working in partnership with the Regional Support Managers. The HR Advisor acts as a coach to the store owners on engagement, retention, performance management talent management and policies and procedures.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Partner with Franchisees and Store Manager on employee relations matters including performance management, compensation, employee engagement and employee relations.

  • Execute business unit visits (changeover and engagement) working collaboratively with business unit to assess engagement and advise on HR Best Practices.

  • Conduct discrimination and harassment investigations, providing recommendations and documentation to the business unit.

  • Partner with the Manager/Owner on CNESST claims and any litigation and act as a trusted advisor on these matters.

  • Where required inform the business unit on labour and employee relations issues to mitigate risk

  • Conduct HR leadership training for business unit on Giant Tiger Talent Development Programs

  • Provide Best advice on Modified work, return to work process and health and safety matters.

  • Act as a conduit between the Manager/Owner and the Centres of Excellence to provide appropriate support.

  • Complete administrative activities for the business unit and reinforce the self-service model

What You'll Bring:

  • Bilingualism English and French is required (expert level, conversational French skills)

  • Post Secondary education in Human Resources or related discipline; or equivalent experience

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in a HR partner/advisor role

  • Skilled in developing positive working relationships with business leaders

  • 3+ years experience coaching and advising managers

  • Excellent attention to detail with written work, with a proven ability to effectively communicate in a positive way with internal business units

  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills

  • Excellent organizataional skills and attention to detail

  • Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines

  • Ability to comprehend, interpret, and apply the appropriate provincial employment law, policies and regulations

  • Relevant experience in conducting ER investigations, including Harassment investigations and supporting MOL & Human Rights claims

  • Travel: The successful candidate must be able and willing to travel as required to support business needs.

Assets You May Have:

  • HR designation such as CHRP or CHRL, either in progress or completed

  • College or University degree in business, HR or a related subject, either in progress or completed

  • Strong computer skills in using Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and Power Point

  • Experience working in Workday

#LI-HYBRID

Giant Tiger is proud to offer a Total Rewards package designed to support your financial security, health, and career growth. This includes competitive compensation for all employees, as well as retirement savings support and comprehensive well-being benefits for our permanent team members.

Salary

$66,000.00 - $99,000.00

Short Term Incentive Plan

Bonus - Short-Term Incentive Plan, 10% Annual

Retirement Support

Bonus - Deferred Profit-Sharing Plan (DPSP), 6% Annual

What Giant Tiger Offers:
Competitive Compensation: The salary range for this position is listed above. Giant Tiger will consider factors such as experience, skills and internal equity to ensure you are paid competitively.


Short Term Incentive Plan: This role includes an annual bonus opportunity based on the percentage of base salary listed above, with payout determined by company and individual performance.


Retirement Support: This role is eligible for company-funded retirement savings, with contributions made on your behalf. The specific retirement program and contribution level are noted above.


Health Benefits and Paid Time Off: Access to our flexible, cost-shared health and dental benefits (available on hire) and annual paid time off, including personal and vacation days, plus additional paid holiday time between Christmas and New Year’s.


Career Growth: Giant Tiger is committed to developing our people. We promote from within, and many of our leaders started right here. We provide the coaching, training, and support you need to build a long-term career. If you're looking for a place to grow and take on new challenges, you've found it.

Extra Giant Tiger Perks:
• Store Discount,
• Parental leave salary top-up,
• Recognition program that celebrates great work with monetary rewards and other perks,
• Safety first environment.

Location

2480 Walkley Road, Ottawa, Ontario, K1G 6A9

Job Requisition

JR132733

Giant Tiger is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fair employment practices.

Giant Tiger will provide support and accommodation in its recruitment processes to all applicants. If you are invited to participate in an interview and have accommodation needs, please contact careers@gianttiger.com.
